findings.title: Version constant compared verbatim with policy version
findings.message: The check sets p.Version from release/version.json, which carries a leading 'v'. checkVersion compares it with the Go constant Version. If the constant omits the 'v' (e.g. "1.0.0"), the check always fails with exit 2. The test fixtures happen to use "v1.0.0", so this mismatch is untested against the real repo format.
findings.suggestion: Confirm that vellum.Version has the same format as release/version.json, and normalize both sides if they differ.

findings.title: Version exception relies on string matching apidiff messages
findings.message: The exception is matched against apidiff's Message text, which is an internal format of the pinned upstream library. If apidiff formats the message differently (e.g. different quoting or wording), the exception never matches. The value change is then reported as incompatible, and the CI check fails on a legitimate Version bump. Conversely, a message change in an update could silently break the exception.
findings.suggestion: Add a test that asserts the exception against the real apidiff output (the existing test covers this case only through the same code path) and consider matching by object name rather than message text.
findings.evidence: return fmt.Sprintf("Version: value changed from %s to %s", a.Val(), b.Val())
